title: Log sklearn RandomForest with skops by trusting its Tree type
answers: mlflow sklearn log_model fails with untrusted type Tree under skops
how do I log a RandomForest model with skops serialization in MLflow
pickle-free sklearn model logging untrusted types error
body:
Default scikit-learn serialization in MLflow is `skops`, and a RandomForest model contains the `sklearn.tree._tree.Tree` type, which skops treats as untrusted.
Pass the reviewed type explicitly: `mlflow.sklearn.log_model(..., skops_trusted_types=["sklearn.tree._tree.Tree"])`.
Use a small `input_example` (for example `X_train[:2]`) so the logged example stays lightweight.
Trust only types you have reviewed; the pickle-free model guidance is at /ml/tracking/pickle-free-models.
The tutorial that shows this pattern is docs/docs/classic-ml/model-registry/tutorial.mdx.
applies: Applies to logging scikit-learn tree-based models (RandomForest) with MLflow's default skops serialization; does not cover other frameworks or pickle-based formats.
